title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles

summary: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts.
takeaways: However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts.
We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation.
We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark's linguistic and cultural coverage.
